TRIP STYLE

River float & drift boat

Cover a river reach from a moving boat. The launch, take-out and river level are part of the trip plan.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who want to cover more water with a guide or a planned shuttle.

Boats & gear

A drift boat, raft or local river boat may suit the reach. Confirm the craft, flotation equipment and tackle with the operator.

Seasons

River level and flow can change the route. Ask about the exact reach and a high-water alternative.
